blogs.title: "Cystic Crossroads": Differentiating Endometriomas From Leiomyomas With Ultrasound And Non-Contrast MRI
blogs.description: "Using classic sonographic signs versus modern low-field MR imaging, this post explains how clinicians distinguish decidualized ovarian cysts from cystically necrotic uterine fibroids during pregnancy, highlighting key wall thickness, vascularity, and signal characteristics"

blogs.title: "Interpreting Tumour Markers In Pregnancy": The Role Of Serial CA 125 Levels
blogs.description: "CA 125 behaves physiologically throughout gestation—with first‐trimester spikes followed by a trough around mid gestation—and serial trends can help discriminate benign degeneration versus malignant change even when absolute values exceed conventional limits"

blogs.title: "When To Operate On A Singleton Mass In The Second Trimester": Clinical Indications And Risks
blogs.description: "A review of maternal lactation pain, dyspnea, torsion risk, infection signs and size progression criteria that prompt surgical intervention versus conservative expectant care in pregnant patients"

blogs.title: "Obstetric Considerations After Mass Excision": Monitoring Fetal Wellbeing And Timing Of Delivery
blogs.description: "This article covers intraoperative fetal heart monitoring protocols, prophylactic hormone therapy post-myomectomy, scar integrity assessment and why an elective Caesarean at term may best protect both mother and child when sizable residual fibroids remain"

blogs.title: "Managing Blood Loss And Iron Deficiency Post‐Myomectomy During Pregnancy"
blogs.description: "Strategies for addressing operative hemorrhage—including transfusion thresholds tailored to gestational physiology—and optimized IV iron replacement regimens needed once massive fibroid removal alters maternal anaemia status"
